sn46.32:1.1: Ye keci bhikkhave dhammā kusalākusalabhāgiyā kusalapakkhikā || sabbe te yoniso manasikāramūlakā yonisomanasikārasamosaraṇā || yonisomanasikāro tesaṃ dhammānam aggam akkhāyati || || 3.
sn46.32:1.2: Yoniso manāsikārasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pātikaṅkhaṃ sattabojjhaṅge bhāvessati sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkarissati || ||
sn46.32:2.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno sattabojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn46.32:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la-pe ||
sn46.32:2.3: Upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn46.32:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta- bahulīkaroti || || 2.
